versions.changelog:
- Removed install/install.sh and install/update.sh scripts.
- Deprecated direct install/update script usage as part of the setup and update process.

SkillBoss 0.1.3 Changelog

- Improved setup flow: now prompts the user to sign up only if the trial API key is in use and only after the first successful request, waiting for user confirmation before proceeding.
- Added handling for trial provisioning rate limits: if provisioning a trial key is rate-limited, users are prompted to sign up for an account instead.
- Refined credential storage and API key resolution order; removed shell env var from defaults.
- Clarified messaging and user flow around account upgrades, trial conversion, and when to prompt for signup.
- Documentation updates for login, credential handling, trial-to-account upgrade, and update enforcement.

SkillBoss 0.1.2 introduces modular documentation and an improved signup flow.

- Split documentation into separate topic files: api-integration.md, billing.md, commands.md, deployment.md, error-handling.md, workflows.md.
- Simplified and shortened the main SKILL.md, moving details to the new topic files for clarity.
- Added a user signup prompt after first successful API request, improving onboarding for trial users.
- Updated CLI command paths in SKILL.md for consistency (`./scripts/skillboss` instead of `./cli/skillboss`).
- Clarified auto-update and low-balance instructions for better reliability and user guidance.

skillboss-2 v0.1.1 adds major new documentation, setup, and extension support.

- Added 91 new files including detailed extension docs and Remotion video generation rules.
- Introduced a new "Authentication & Setup" section with trial and permanent account instructions.
- Added "Auto-Update" instructions and mandatory version update workflow.
- Launched the `pilot` command for auto-selecting, discovering, and executing any AI model or workflow.
- Updated quick start and commands to reflect new CLI structure, authentication process, and best practices.
- Included new config and extension support for Remotion and advanced video asset workflows.

skillboss-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of SkillBoss: a multi-AI gateway for building and deploying full-stack applications.
- Supports website/app deployment, payments (Stripe), user authentication (OAuth/OTP), email and SMS, AI image/audio/video generation, and more.
- Integrates 50+ AI APIs including OpenAI, HuggingFace, FAL, Minimax, and others.
- Provides unified Bash commands for tasks like chat, image upscaling, document parsing, music and video generation.
- Enables cloud deployment (Cloudflare Workers), database (D1/KV/R2), web scraping/search, and CEO interview/quote lookup.
- Comprehensive documentation and quick start command examples included in SKILL.md.
